business_problem: "Microsoft is our number one vendor," explains Geraint Morgan, IT Director at Softcat. "It's absolutely important to us that we're at the forefront of using the Microsoft technology stack effectively.
solution_summary: Softcat is the UK's largest Microsoft partner and aims to lead the adoption of Microsoft technologies for the benefit of its customers. "Microsoft is our number one vendor," explains Geraint Morgan, IT Director at Softcat. "It's absolutely important to us that we're at the forefront of using the Microsoft technology stack effectively. Softcat began exploring the potential of Microsoft 365 Copilot in October 2023. It is now implementing an organisation-wide adoption. Softcat began small, starting with ten licences so that a group of IT users could assess the data governance implications of using Copilot. The implementation centers on Copilot for Microsoft 365, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365, Excel to support enterprise knowledge search workflows.

solution_components.name: Copilot for Microsoft 365
solution_components.role: Provides the employee assistant used to summarize, draft, and retrieve information in day-to-day work.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Teams
solution_components.role: Acts as the collaboration surface for prompts, meetings, and shared knowledge.

solution_components.name: Microsoft 365
solution_components.role: Provides the productivity suite where the new workflows are delivered to employees.

solution_components.name: Excel
solution_components.role: Provides spreadsheet workbooks that users analyze or summarize inside the workflow.

business_outcome: Softcat is the UK's largest Microsoft partner and aims to lead the adoption of Microsoft technologies for the benefit of its customers.
metrics: Elsewhere, the business has also had incredible success using Copilot to assist with RFP review and vendor assessments. The team estimates it has taken around 45 hours out of each of those tasks through their use of Copilot.
